sentences.text: During the pendency of the petition, petitioner No.1 and respondent No.3 have arrived at a compromise.

Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.3 have filed their respective affidavits, which reads as under:
"AFFIDAVIT OF PETITIONER NO.1 I, Mr. Ashrafali S/o Abdul Kareem Madiwale,
Age: 27 years, Occ: Coolie, R/o: Kali Ambrai, Belagavi-590001, today.

at Belagavi do hereby state on solemn affirmation for me and on behalf of Petitioner No.2 to 10.
1.
I submit that I am Petitioner No.1/accused No.1 in the above petition.
I am well NC: 2024:KHC-D:14839 conversant with the facts of the case, I am competent to swear this following affidavit.

2. I submit that respondent No.3 is my wife, all other petitioners are my mother,
in-law and other distant relatives.
My marriage with the respondent No.3 is solemnized on 13/05/2016 with my knowledge and it was arrange marriage from both family members.
I submit that we have laid a happy marriage life, out of said wedlock 3 children where born.
I am working as a coolie on daily basis and maintaining my family.
3. I submit that the paragraph from 1 to 6 of the accompanying application are true and correct to the best of my knowledge, information and belief and the same is true and correct.
4. I state that contents of the affidavit are true and correct to the best of my knowledge.
WHEREFORE, I pray that this Hon'ble Court be pleased to allow the accompanying application as prayed for in the interest of justice.

AFFIDAVIT OF RESPONDENT NO.3 Herein, I Smt. Samina W/o Ashrafali Madiwale, Age: 24 years, Occ: House Hold, R/o:
Kali Ambrai, Belagavi-590001, today at Belagavi, do hereby state on solemn affirmation and make this Affidavit as under,
1.
That, I am the above-named victim in the top-noted Criminal Petition and I am fully conversant with facts and circumstances of this case.
Now, I have also turned 24 years and hence, I am competent to swear to this affidavit.

sentences.text: Sections 9 & 10 of Child Marriage Restraint Act, have approached this court with prayer to quash the entire proceedings in the said case.
3. That, myself and the Petitioner No.1 herein have got married on 13/05/2016 at Bhanki Village, Tq: Khanapur, Dist: Belagavi, the same was arrange marriage by the family members from both sides.
Thereafter, we both started to live as Husband and Wife at Belagavi.

That on 18/10/2019 I have filed a complaint before the police that during my minority in 2015 one Mahantesh Balesh Chavan has spoiled sexually,
same is registered in Nandgad PS Crime No. 107/2019 for the offences punishable under Section 376, 506 of IPC and Section. 4 & 6 of POCSO Act 2012.

During investigation my Section 164 of Cr.P.C. statement is recorded wherein I have disclosed that my marriage with the petitioner No.1 was performed on 13/05/2016 at Bhanki village Masjid, which is arrange marriage out of the said marriage one daughter is born.
Based on that statement the PSI/respondent No.2 has filed this case against my husband, my father and mother and other relatives.
I submit that base on presumption the respondent No.2 has filed baseless complaint against the petitioners.
4. That, on the other hand the said marriage solemnized on 13/05/2016 was with my knowledge and it was the arrange marriage, of the family members of the both side.

Thus, the respondent No.2 without considering the reality in this regard, has filed FIR, respondent No.1 has filed final report/Charge-sheet against the said petitioners,
the entire charge sheet is based on false, baseless allegations.
5. That, the Marriage between myself and Petitioner No.1/ Accused No.1 herein has been NC: 2024:KHC-D:14839 performed, from the said wedlock 3 children are also born and we all are residing happily.

6. That, the Petitioners are herein has not committed any of the above alleged offences that are leveled against them in the FIR and Charge- Sheet and I have no objection to quash/Close the above entire criminal proceedings That, the above charges leveled against the Petitioners including my husband, be kindly quashed as pending before the trail court in the said special case no. 71/2020.

7. That, am filing this Affidavit on my own and not under undue influence, coercion or fraud and after understanding that my husband i.e., Petitioner No.1/accused No.1 herein that he is innocent and my entire family who are my in-law, father and mother and other relatives who are also innocent.

sentences.text: That, if the said criminal proceedings against the Petitioners is not quashed or closed then, I and the children born from our wedlock we'll be deprived of the family life, at a such a young age of our married life.
Further, there will be misconception between Petitioners and myself and so also between theour family members.
Hence, no purpose would be served in continuing the said further proceedings as against the Petitioners herein and on the other hand it would ruined our family life.
Therefore, for securing the ends of justice I request this Hon'ble court to allow this Criminal Petition by quashing the said proceedings against the petitioner herein.

Wherefore, it most respectfully prayed by the victim (me) to this Hon'ble Court that, entire proceedings in Special case No. 71/2020 pending before the Addl. Dist. & Sessions Judge- FTSC-I Belagavi (POCSO) AT: Belagavi, arising out of Crime no. 124/2019 Registered by Nandgad Police Station, for the offence punishable under section 4 & 18 of POCSO Act, Sections 9 & 10 of Child Marriage Restraint Act against the Petitioner No.1 NC: 2024:KHC-D:14839 to 10 are herein is my husband, in-laws, mother, father and other relatives, who are arrayed as Accused No.1 to 10 in the said proceedings, be kindly quashed, by allowing this Criminal Petition, by this Hon'ble court, in the interest of justice and equity."
3.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The facts reveals that respondent No.2 had filed a complaint against petitioners, which is registered in Nandagadh P.S.Crime No.124/2019 for the offences punishable under Sections 4 and 18 of POCSO Act and Sections 9 and 10 of Prohibition of Child Marriage Act 2006.
Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.3 are husband and wife.
The marriage was solemnized during the minority of respondent No.3.
As per the compromise, petitioner No.1 and respondent No.3 are living as husband and wife and they have three children from their marriage.

The application i.e.,
memorandum of compromise petition filed under Section 482 (Sec.528 of BNSS Act 2023) R/w Section 320(2) (Section 359(2) of BNSS) of the Cr.P.C is duly signed by petitioner No.1 and respondent No.3 and their respective counsel.
Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.3 are present before this Court.

5. Learned counsel on both sides submits that present petition is squarely covered by the decision of Co- ordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Petition No.102180/2023 in the case of Pundalik S/o Devappa Ghadi (Gadi) v. The State of Karnataka and Others, wherein in identical circumstances on the compromise entered, impugned proceedings have been quashed and the said decision is squarely applicable to the present facts of this case.
